text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning countless races
together with Rhein Kraft...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: La, la, la~.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
it's finally time, isn't it~

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Now is the perfect time to dive into some ice cream!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I made a mistake.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's a hot spring trip~.
Now is the time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I had a hot spring trip voucher won from the lottery.
Back then, the timing made it difficult to go, but..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, Cesario told me,
'Isn't it about time?'"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
She actually remembered
how excited I was~.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: We have some time right now anyway. Think of it as a reward for working so hard up to this point!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Let's relax and enjoy some cozy healing~.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Waah~.
Amazing, amazing!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
Where should we start, and what should we do first?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Do they have milk stands and stuff too, I wonder~?
You know, for after the bath!"
choice_data_list: Was it a dead end, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Haaee!
That's our Trainer for ya!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: You really know everything, don't you?
choice_data_list: I just did a little research, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry!
I came totally empty-handed without
thinking at all...
choice_data_list: As long as you're smiling, that's more than enough!
As long as you're smiling, that's enough for me!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe,
then I'll make sure to smile lots and lots!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "Let's go for a nice long stroll, and then hit the hot springs!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~...
So nice and warm...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
What should we do after this!?
Going back into town and continuing our stroll sounds lovely too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I bet the atmosphere is
completely different at night~!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because my body and mind relaxed after walking so much
and soaking in the hot spring... A gentle drowsiness is washing over me...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Lullaby, go to sleep~.
The sun is warm, so very warm.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"In the sky, the warm sun shines bright and glowy~
Keeping you cozy, wrapped up in its warmth~"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's alright, Trainer-san.
Today is all about taking it easy and unwinding, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Let's take it slow
and get some rest!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's okay. I'll be watching over you,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Just that
is more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Even though all I do
is rely on you, Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Because I can even become
your patch of sunshine.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Just this once!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Warm and cozy, wrapping around you.
Warm and cozy, toasty and warm, pip-pop-po~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft's gentle, sunny song...
The steady rhythm feels so soothing,
and my consciousness sinks deeper and deeper...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer?
Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Good night.
My sun..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond
with Rhein Kraft...
